subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Shelby Cobra
description: A fast breakdown of The Shelby Cobra for builders.

hook.text: Carroll Shelby stuffed a massive Ford V8 into a tiny British sports car. The result was terrifying.

buildup.text: The AC Ace was a lightweight roadster. Ford's 289 V8 gave it a power-to-weight ratio that was insane.

discovery.text: The Cobra could outrun Ferraris and Corvettes costing twice as much—raw American power in a British shell.

twist.text: Shelby was a chicken farmer and ex-race driver with a heart condition. Nobody expected him to succeed.

climax.text: Original Cobras now sell for millions. Replicas outnumber originals by at least fifty to one.

punchline.text: A farmer built one of the most valuable cars ever.

quiz.question: What was Carroll Shelby's background before cars?

details.summary: The Shelby Cobra, born when Carroll Shelby stuffed a Ford V8 into a lightweight British AC Ace body in 1962, became the ultimate Anglo-American muscle car and a legend of speed and simplicity.
details.whyItMatters: The Cobra proved that combining a powerful American engine with a light European chassis created something greater than the sum of its parts, defining a formula still used today.
takeaways: Carroll Shelby paired a Ford V8 with a lightweight AC Ace body
The 427 Cobra could accelerate from 0 to 100 and back to 0 in under 14 seconds
Original Cobras now sell for millions at auction

faq.question: How many original Shelby Cobras were built?
faq.answer: Only about 998 original Cobras were produced between 1962 and 1967. Their rarity, racing heritage, and iconic status make them among the most valuable American cars ever, with prices exceeding 5 million dollars.

faq.question: Why are there so many replica Cobras?
faq.answer: The Cobra's simple ladder frame and fiberglass body are easy to replicate. Dozens of companies sell replica kits, making the Cobra the most reproduced car in history. Authentic originals are vanishingly rare.
